public_records.note: County parcel records supply the mailing address and the last recorded sale when the layer includes them. Water and irrigation districts are left out. Miami-Dade's parcel layer has no last-sale date or price. Clark County's free parcel layer has mailing address and last sale. It does not include year built or assessed value.
